name: iAmAI – AI SEO & GEO Autopilot for Hebrew Sites
author: iAmAI

sections.description:
iAmAI is SEO and GEO (generative engine optimization) on autopilot. Connect your site once, and the iAmAI service keeps improving what Google and AI tools such as ChatGPT read on your site: titles and descriptions, structured data, image alt text, internal links, llms.txt, and new articles that you approve.

The words on your pages stay the same. Every change is saved, and you can undo it in one click: one change, several, or all of them. You can also pause or disconnect at any time.

What you get

  • Clearer pages for Google: better titles and descriptions, written through Yoast SEO or Rank Math when one of them is active, so nothing is duplicated.
  • Clearer pages for AI tools (GEO): structured data (schema.org) for your business, products, FAQ and breadcrumbs, plus an /ai-info/ page with your business details.
  • Technical basics: llms.txt, robots.txt lines, canonical.
  • Alt text for images that have none.
  • Internal links between your own pages (Pro and Business): words that are already on a page become a link to another page of your site. The page text is never edited, and each link can be undone on its own.
  • New articles every month (3 on Basic, 5 on Pro, 10 on Business), each with its own cover image, published only after you approve them.
  • Rankings: your place in Google for the searches we check, with a weekly check and up to 5 competing sites.
  • Google Search Console (Pro and Business, optional, read-only), to show how pages moved after a change.
  • A monthly email report: what we changed, how the site moved in Google, and your AI score.

Who it is for

  • Business owners who want to be found on Google and in AI answers, without learning SEO.
  • Online stores on WooCommerce and service sites.
  • Sites that already use Yoast SEO or Rank Math: iAmAI works through their fields.
  • Hebrew sites in Israel: the service, the plugin screens, the articles and the support are in Hebrew.

How it works

  1. Choose a plan on https://www.iam-ai.co.il (you can run a free scan of your site there first).
  2. Install the plugin and paste the connection code from your iAmAI account. Prefer that we do it? Installation is on us, free.
  3. That’s it. Improvements arrive on their own, articles come to you by email for approval, and every change shows up in the plugin with an Undo button.

Built for Hebrew and RTL sites

  • The plugin screens are in Hebrew (right to left) and English.
  • Articles are written in natural Hebrew for Israeli businesses.
  • Rankings are checked for Hebrew searches.
  • Support in Hebrew by email (office@iam-ai.co.il) and WhatsApp.
  • Prices in shekels, on our website only. There is no payment inside the plugin.

What it never touches

The text on your pages, prices, products, orders, design and theme, other plugins, users. Only site admins see the plugin.

Plans

The plugin does nothing until you paste a connection code from your iAmAI account. There is no payment inside the plugin. Plans are chosen on our website: Basic ₪299, Pro ₪599 and Business ₪1,199 per month. Free installation, a full refund in the first month, and you can cancel any month. We do not promise rankings, traffic, or mentions in AI answers.

External services

This plugin connects to the iAmAI service, run by iAmAI (https://iam-ai.co.il). It is needed for the plugin to do anything: the service decides which improvements to make. No call is made on activation; the first call happens only after you paste a connection code and click “Connect”.

Calls, all over HTTPS to https://api.iam-ai.co.il:

  • POST /api/wp/v1/connect, once, when you click “Connect”. Sends: the code you pasted, your site address, the plugin, WordPress and PHP versions, and which SEO plugin is active. Receives: this site’s connection id and secret.
  • POST /api/wp/v1/sync, about once an hour while connected. Sends: the plugin, WordPress and PHP versions, the active SEO plugin, the plugin’s mode (active, paused, suggestions only), how many changes are applied or undone, which change types you allow, whether internal links are added automatically or with your approval, and the result of each change (applied, skipped, undone). Receives: the service state (active, pilot ended, paused by us), your pilot day, your site score, and new changes as data (texts, schema.org data and internal links given as existing words plus a page address of this site; never code), and which internal links to undo or put back.
  • POST /api/wp/v1/gsc, only when you click “Connect Google Search Console”. Sends nothing but the plugin version. Receives: a Google consent link. You then sign in at Google (https://accounts.google.com) and allow read-only access to Search Console for this site; Google sends you back here. The service keeps that access encrypted and only reads clicks, impressions and average position of the pages it changed, to measure each change 30 days later. Google’s privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • POST /api/wp/v1/links, when you open the internal links screen. Sends nothing but the plugin version. Receives: the internal links the service made on this site (the words, the page they sit on, the page they lead to, the status) and their counts.
  • POST /api/wp/v1/links/undo, when you undo one internal link. Sends: that link’s id. The service then never adds that link again.
  • POST /api/wp/v1/links/approve and /api/wp/v1/links/reject, only if you chose to approve links yourself (Settings), when you approve or reject a suggested link. Sends: that link’s id.
  • POST /api/wp/v1/articles, with every sync and when you open the Articles screen. Sends: the plugin version and what happened to each article here (draft created with its post id and featured image address, published with its address, moved back to draft, removed, failed). Receives: the articles to create as drafts (title, text, description, questions and answers; data only, checked with wp_kses_post), which approved articles to schedule or publish, which skipped ones to remove, your monthly article count, the list the Articles screen shows, and the business details for the /ai-info/ page.
  • POST /api/wp/v1/articles/image, once per new article. Sends: the article id. Receives: its cover image (generated for the article, never taken from another site), which is added to your Media Library as the post’s featured image.
  • POST /api/wp/v1/articles/decide, when you click “Approve and publish” or “Skip” on the Articles screen. Sends: the article id and your choice.
  • POST /api/wp/v1/rankings, when you open the Rankings screen (all plans). Sends nothing but the plugin version. Receives: the searches we check for this site, its place in Google for each (weekly check, and Search Console averages if you connected it on our site), and the competing sites. POST /api/wp/v1/rankings/competitors, when you add or remove a competitor. Sends: that site address.
  • POST /api/wp/v1/account-link, only when you click “To my account”. Sends nothing but the plugin version. Receives: a one-time link to your account on our site (https://www.iam-ai.co.il/account), valid for 2 minutes and usable once. It opens in a new tab, where one click signs you in without a password.
  • POST /api/wp/v1/disconnect, when you click “Disconnect”.

Articles: every article is emailed to the site owner by the service and is published only after it is approved (by email or on the Articles screen). The plugin adds the page /ai-info/ with your business details as the service read them on your own public pages (each with its source page); it is not added to any menu, and it is listed in the sitemap and in llms.txt.

While changes are waiting, the service may ask for the next sync sooner (never more often than once a minute). The service can also ask for a sync right away by calling this site’s REST route POST /wp-json/iamai/v1/ping. That request is signed with the per-site secret, accepted at most once a minute, carries no data, and only starts a normal sync.

The service reads your public pages from the web to prepare changes. The plugin never sends customer, order or user data, and no passwords. Calls are signed with a per-site secret.

Terms of use: https://www.iam-ai.co.il/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.iam-ai.co.il/privacy
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New, search for “iAmAI”, then install and activate it.
  2. Open iAmAI in the admin menu, paste the connection code from your iAmAI account, and click “Connect”.
  3. That’s it. Improvements start arriving on their own.

Prefer that we install it? Installation is on us, free: write to office@iam-ai.co.il.
sections.faq:
What is GEO?

GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for AI tools such as ChatGPT to read and understand: clear titles and descriptions, structured data, llms.txt and a page with your business details. iAmAI does it together with classic SEO for Google.

Will it get me to first place on Google, or into ChatGPT’s answers?

No one can promise that, and we don’t. iAmAI improves what Google and AI tools read on your site. Results depend on things outside our control, such as Google’s and the AI tools’ algorithms, your competition and your content.

Does it change the text on my pages?

No. We change only SEO data and the links between your pages. The words on your pages stay the same.

Can I undo a change?

Yes. Each change has an “Undo” button, and there is also “Undo all”. Deleting the plugin undoes every change that is still applied.

Will an article be published without me?

No. Every article is emailed to you first, and it is published only after you approve it, by email or on the Articles screen. If you skip it, we write a different one instead.

I use Yoast SEO or Rank Math

That’s fine. The plugin writes titles, descriptions and canonical through their own fields, and leaves them the schema types they already print.

Is it in Hebrew? Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes to both. The plugin screens are in Hebrew and English, articles are written in Hebrew, and support is in Hebrew. On WooCommerce stores the service also adds product structured data and fixes the titles of store pages such as cart and checkout.

Do I need an account? What does it cost?

Yes. The plugin works only with an iAmAI plan: Basic ₪299, Pro ₪599 or Business ₪1,199 per month, chosen on https://www.iam-ai.co.il. You get the connection code in your account there. Installation is free, there is a full refund in the first month, and you can cancel any month.
sections.changelog:
2.2.2

  • New name, “iAmAI – AI SEO & GEO Autopilot for Hebrew Sites”, and a rewritten plugin page. No code changes: the plugin works exactly as before.

2.2.1

  • Not connected yet and no code? A new line under “Enter code” opens your account on our website, where you can get a fresh connection code by email.
  • Rankings: the “Connect Google Search Console” button now goes straight to Google, like the one on the Overview.

2.2.0

  • New “To my account” button in Settings and on the Overview. It opens your account on our website in a new tab, without a password. It replaces the “Manage on our site” link.
  • Right after you connect, one screen shows what happens next: the first scan, the first changes, rankings tonight at 02:00, and articles that come to you by email for approval.

2.1.0

  • New look with the new iAmAI logo, and a simpler menu: Overview, Changes, Articles, Rankings, Settings.
  • Articles: drafts with a cover image, published only after you approve them (by email or on the Articles screen). Adds the /ai-info/ page with your business details.
  • Rankings: your place in Google for the searches we track, and up to 5 competitors.
  • Internal links (Pro plan and up): the service can link words already on a page to another page of the same site. Links are added when the page is shown, so the page text is never edited, and each link can be undone (and put back) on its own.
  • New Links tab on the Changes page (Pro plan and up): every link with its page, its words and where it leads; undo one or several, or put one back. A new Internal links switch in Settings. Old Links screen bookmarks open the new tab.

2.0.6

  • Before a plan is active the plugin shows one neutral ‘Not active yet’ screen with a link to our site; it changes nothing on the site until then.
  • On the Pro plan, the overview shows the monthly AI-tools report (score, questions asked, each AI tool).
  • If the plan ends (cancel or refund), the plugin stops getting new changes and the changes already made stay.

2.0.5

  • If the service address cannot be reached, the copy downloaded from our site tries its second address (named below) and remembers it for an hour.

2.0.4

  • New “What improved” card: for each changed page, clicks and average position in the 28 days before vs. after the change (from Google Search Console).
  • “Connect Google Search Console” button (read-only access, optional).

2.0.3

  • Syncs once right after an update (on the next admin page load), so waiting changes arrive without pressing Sync.
  • A ping from the service now syncs immediately instead of waiting for WP-Cron (which cached sites may never run).
  • Overview shows the Google readiness score even before the first AI check.

2.0.2

  • Faster delivery: follows the service’s suggested sync interval (every minute while changes are waiting, otherwise hourly).
  • The service can ask for an immediate sync through a signed, rate-limited REST route (POST /wp-json/iamai/v1/ping). It carries no data.

2.0.1

  • Corrected titles keep the owner’s original value for undo: when a later change replaces one of ours, undo goes back to what was there before our first change, not to our previous text.
  • Requires the matching server release for WooCommerce system-page titles (cart, checkout, my-account).

2.0.0

  • Rewrite. One-time connection code, signed calls, change log with undo, undo all and redo, pause, Yoast SEO and Rank Math support, structured data, alt text, FAQ, llms.txt, new admin screens in Hebrew and English.
  • Upgrading from 1.9.x: titles and descriptions written by 1.9.x keep working and can now be undone. The old snapshot tables are left in place. Reconnect once with a code.
